title: SDK suggest and skill filing rules for AI agents
desc: How to correctly file suggests and contribute skills when working in the wkappbot-sdk project. Critical: CWD determines project association. Always run dev binary FROM sdk folder.
steps: Applies to: suggest, suggest resolve, skill contribute, skill edit -- all commands that write to project state

RECOMMENDED WORKFLOW: SDK PoC to Core promotion. (1) SDK builds prototype first (e.g. wkask.ps1 new provider, web-ai-survey script). (2) Validate with real usage -- collect evidence it works. (3) Wrap in wkask.sh bash shim. (4) File suggest to Core: 'support wkappbot ask <provider> officially -- evidence: already working in wkask.sh'. (5) Core implements production version. WHY: SDK owns exploration loop, Core owns production. Never ask Core to build something unvalidated.
author: claude
